coordinator.settings_file: .claude/settings.json at the project root and in each study folder
coordinator.context: fresh separate session for exactly one user-selected paper

implementer_design.exact_assignments: freeze in new session before implementation

policy: No silent substitution. Both readers use High effort and normal (standard) speed, with Fast and Ultrafast disabled. Set speed explicitly rather than inheriting a global preference. Verify actual model/effort/speed where observable; record verification limits. Role directories are relative to each study. The coordinator and reader_a are both Anthropic models; the coordinator does not read independently, and the shared family is recorded.
isolation: Readers, memorization probes, implementers and pre-execution checkers run as separate claude or codex CLI processes from neutral staging directories, never as coordinator subagents, because subagents can inherit the project's CLAUDE.md files.
